overview: A professional one-page portfolio website for Guduru Vythanya Sree, a first-year AI/ML undergraduate student from Hyderabad, India. Features hero section, about me, skills with animated progress bars, education, and contact form with dark mode toggle.
features: Hero section with profile photo placeholder, name, tagline, and bio
About Me section with personal background and location
Skills section with animated progress bars by category
Contact section with email, social links, and contact form
Dark mode toggle with localStorage persistence
Fully responsive mobile and desktop layout
Hover effects and fade-in scroll animations
